hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/client/node_modules/*) ;; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/client/*.js|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/client/*.vue|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/client/*.json|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/client/*.css) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/client/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
